SELECT sda.employee_id AS employee_id, sda.identity_card AS identity_card, DATE_FORMAT(sda.attendance_date, '%Y-%m') AS monthly, sda.employee_name AS employee_name, sp.phone_number AS phone_number, fwg.work_group_name AS team, sp.job_type AS job_type, SUM(CASE WHEN sda.clock_in_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attendance_date_total, CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sda.clock_in_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / (DATEDIFF(#{endDate}, #{startDate}) + 1), 2),'%') AS attendance_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN sda.attendance_normal = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_attendance_total, SUM(sda.actual_hours) AS actual_hours_total, SUM(sda.idle_hours) AS idle_hours_total FROM swm_daily_attendance sda LEFT JOIN swm_person sp ON sp.identity_card = sda.identity_card AND sp.NAME = sda.employee_name LEFT JOIN fms_work_group fwg ON sp.team = fwg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE sp.personnel_status = '1' AND sp.STATUS = '0' AND sda.attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY sda.employee_id, sda.employee_name

SELECT sda.id, sda.employee_id, sda.classes, sda.attendance_date, sda.employee_name, sda.identity_card, sda.clock_in_date, sda.clock_out_date, sda.scheduled_hours, sda.actual_hours, sp.department, fpa.position_name as departmentName, sp.team, fwg.work_group_name as teamName FROM swm_daily_attendance sda LEFT JOIN swm_person sp ON sda.identity_card = sp.identity_card AND sp.STATUS = '0' AND sp.personnel_status = '1' LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive fpa ON sp.department = fpa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group fwg ON sp.team = fwg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE sda.STATUS = 0 AND sda.attendance_date >= #{startDate} AND sda.attendance_date <= #{endDate}
